meta.title: Yellowing skin with dark urine
meta.candidate_brief: You are seeing this patient in the medical admissions unit after referral by their GP for new jaundice. Take a focused history and identify key concerns.

patient_script.opening_statement: My skin looks yellow and my urine has gone really dark.

if_asked.symptom_details: Friends pointed out my eyes were yellow last week, and I've noticed my pee is like tea.
if_asked.timing: First noticed five days ago, getting a bit more obvious each day.
if_asked.after_effects: I feel tired and a bit nauseated but no vomiting.
if_asked.exacerbating: Nothing particular makes it worse but I'm more aware after eating greasy food.
if_asked.relieving: Resting helps with the fatigue but the yellow color stays.
if_asked.associated_symptoms: I've had some right upper tummy discomfort, poor appetite, and pale stools. No fevers or confusion.
if_asked.past_medical_history: I had mononucleosis at university but otherwise healthy.
if_asked.medications: I take a combined oral contraceptive pill and paracetamol occasionally for headaches.
if_asked.family_history: No liver disease in the family; mum has hypothyroidism.
if_asked.social_history: I don't smoke, drink socially maybe 6 units a week, work as a barista, live with two roommates, and I got a tattoo at a studio abroad two months ago.
if_asked.functional_status: I've missed a couple shifts because I feel wiped out.

collateral.observer_note: Roommate noticed she has been more tired and off food.

patient_script.emotional_tone: Concerned but cooperative, occasionally rubs right upper abdomen

pc.one_liner: My skin and eyes have turned yellow.

hpc.character: Yellow discoloration with dark urine and pale stools
hpc.relieving: Rest provides mild relief of tiredness

sh.recreational_drugs: Occasional cannabis at parties (last use 1 month ago)
sh.occupation_detail: Early morning shifts, handles drinks and cash

ice.ideas: Wonders if it might be something wrong with her liver
ice.concerns: Scared it could be permanent damage
ice.expectations: Hopes to find out what's causing it and if she needs to stay in hospital
